- **Recount**:: The last few days have been very busy and today started horribly.
- **Recount**:: Since Sunday, I have been working on setting up the data for Hive's behavioral platform. This started relatively straightforward, but grew to be very tedious and complex. So much so, that last night I stayed at work until 2000 and still had not finished all the work needed to get Dooble the data in the right format this week. Getting home that late has left me pretty tired and close to worn out. I am happy that I will hopefully have almost all of October off because I am working extra days this month.
